definitions.explanation: A pattern of stripes running horizontally (left to right). Common in clothing and fabric design.

examples.japanese: {横縞|よこじま}のTシャツが{好|す}きだ。
{赤|あか}と{白|しろ}の{横縞|よこじま}はフランスっぽい{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: Red and white horizontal stripes have a French feel.

examples.japanese: {横縞|よこじま}の{模様|もよう}は{体|からだ}を{横|よこ}に{広|ひろ}く{見|み}せると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Horizontal stripe patterns are said to make the body look wider.

notes:
A pattern of stripes running horizontally (left to right), common in clothing and fabric design.

FORMS:
{横|よこ} (horizontal/sideways) + {縞|しま} (stripes)

FASHION NOTE:
In Japanese fashion terminology, horizontal stripes are often called ボーダー (from English "border"). A ボーダーシャツ or ボーダーTシャツ specifically means a horizontally striped shirt.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横縞|よこじま}: horizontal stripes (said to make the body look wider)
- {縦縞|たてじま}: vertical stripes (said to make the body look taller/slimmer)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {横縞|よこじま}の{模様|もよう}: horizontal stripe pattern
- {横縞|よこじま}のシャツ: horizontally striped shirt
- {赤|あか}と{白|しろ}の{横縞|よこじま}: red and white horizontal stripes
